message.content:
To **log in to OneDrive**, go to the OneDrive sign-in page, enter the email address for your Microsoft account, then enter your password and complete any verification prompts.[1][6][10]

If you want the basic steps:

- Open the OneDrive sign-in page.[1]
- Enter your Microsoft account email address.[6]
- Click **Next** and enter your password.[2][6]
- Complete any prompts such as **Stay signed in** or multi-factor authentication if asked.[2][4]
- After signing in, you can access your files in OneDrive.[7][10]

If you are using the **OneDrive app** on Windows or Mac, you may need to open the app from your computer, then select **Sign in** and use your Microsoft account credentials.[4][5]

If you’re having trouble, common fixes include checking that you’re using the correct account type, clearing browser cache, trying another browser, or verifying that OneDrive service is working.[3]
